questions: When a customer pays more money later, should I add it to the deposit on that order, or is the deposit only entered once when the order is taken?
Can an order be marked as collected while the customer still owes money, or must it be fully paid first?
Should each order keep the measurements used for that garment, or does each customer have just one set of measurements that you update when they change?
answers: No, measurements are kept on the customer.
